g.text: Multi-Tenant Cloud Kitchen SaaS • Real-Time Fleet Logistics • Subscription & Eco-Box Lifecycle
Fields: mobile, pin, staffId, bizId, branchId
Full copy of Customers, Plans, Staff
Box Status: Clean, Dirty, Damaged + Notes
Real-time driver breadcrumbs on Live Map
Complete Isolation per Tenant (Kitchen Owner UID)
1. Super Admin: Unrestricted read/write across all tenants
2. Kitchen Owner: Bound strictly to {userId} == request.auth.uid
3. Anti-Tampering: Owner cannot modify trialClaimed or planExpiryDate
4. Driver Boundary: Whitelisted writes: status, GPS, attendance only
5. Anonymous Guard: Background driver session authentication bridge
Platform tier pricing, feature flags, maintenance mode
Broadcast announcements to all kitchen owners & managers
Browser IndexedDB + Memory Persistence for sandbox safety
